  Muhammad ka kaisa gharaana hai dekho
  Shah-e-diṅ ko jangal basaana hai dekho

  1
  Hai Akbar ka laasha para ran meiṅ logoṅ
  Kisi ghamzade ko uthaana hai dekho
  Shah-e-diṅ ko jangal basaana hai dekho

  2
  Bhara ghar lutaaya hai imaaṅ ki khaatir
  Abhi tak ye rota zamaana hai dekho
  Shah-e-diṅ ko jangal basaana hai dekho

  3
  Qayaamat hai Yasrab ki godi ke paale
  Kata kar gala diṅ bachaana hai dekho
  Shah-e-diṅ ko jangal basaana hai dekho

  4
  Na tha tujh ko laazim sawaar-e-Muhammad
  Muqaddar meiṅ laashe uthaana hai dekho
  Shah-e-diṅ ko jangal basaana hai dekho

  5
  Kata kar ye pyaasa gala zer-e-khanjar

  Shah-e-diṅ ko jangal basaana hai dekho

  6
  Mare jo mohabbat meiṅ Aal-e-Nabi ke
